name: Cutroom
tagline: Edit videos by chat, review the plan, approve the render.
description: Cutroom helps creators edit uploaded footage through conversation. Describe the changes you want, review the proposed cuts, captions and overlays, and approve a preview before rendering the final export. The workflow keeps the edit plan visible so you can inspect and revise the result. New accounts get free credits with no credit card required; paid plans start at $9.9/month.
